info.title: API.SH: Skroutz
info.description: The Skroutz API from API.SH: public Skroutz data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
User reviews of a Skroutz product: id, rating, author (the site's username; full names shortened to first name and initial), the name, profile link and avatar as the page shows them (`author_name`, `author_profile_url`, `author_avatar`), date, text, purchased flag, helpful votes, best-pick flag, images and the variant the review is about. Filter by star rating. The first call returns 30; pass `next_offset` back as `offset` for the next 10; null at the end.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/skroutz-reviews

get.summary: Skroutz product search and category listings
get.description:
Search Skroutz (Greece) or browse a category, brand page or shop's listing with every filter the site offers: the answer lists the filter groups (price bands, deals, manufacturers, delivery, store pickup and the category's specifications) with option ids, counts and the `path` to pass back to apply one, plus price_min/price_max and a sort. A search lands where skroutz.gr sends it (a category, a brand page or the cross-category results; `landed_on` says which). Each product: id, name, link, lowest price, number of shops, the cheapest shop, rating and review count, image, category, specification summary, variations, installments, delivery label, badges, sponsored flag and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/skroutz-search

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: A listing path from a filter option's `path` (or a Skroutz listing link).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A shop's page on Skroutz: name, categories, phone, marketplace-only and official-reseller flags, rating, review count, positive and negative review counts, weekly orders and time on Skroutz, and buyer reviews (username, date, verified purchase, text, pros and cons, the shop's reply). Filter reviews to positive or negative. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/skroutz-shop

parameters.name: shop
parameters.description: Numeric shop id (as in /shop/<id>/), or a shop link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products a shop sells on Skroutz, with the same filters, sort and fields as /skroutz/v1/search (pass a filter option's `path` to narrow). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/skroutz-shop-products

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
